_comment: IMPORTANT: these URLs are UNVERIFIED. The Main Roads hosts were unreachable
from the environment this app was written in, so the exact endpoint could not
be confirmed. Run 'python check_sources.py' to test them. If a URL is wrong,
find the right one on the Main Roads open data portal (search for 'WebEOC Road
Incidents' and 'Traffic Cameras'), copy its GeoJSON / FeatureServer query URL
The app works without these - it just won't have incident data, and will say so.
